note: Fees from the Diplomatic and Consular Fees (Amendment) Regulations 2019; later amendments not yet checked. The same schedule prices processing within 5 working days at a Passport Office (EUR 75 more) or the same working day (EUR 150 more), on the counter fees, and within 5 working days online (EUR 40 more), each written as an urgent route; the passport card is EUR 35 (reference 9), taken as applied for online, its validity not in the schedule (a lead); the online fee for a passport and a card together (EUR 100 for an adult's 34 pages against 75 and 35 apart; 130, 45 and 75) is a bundle the form doesn't hold. Validity is prescribed by the Minister under the Passports Act 2008, s. 9, in regulations not yet found. ireland.ie answers this client with 403 and the Oireachtas site with a CAPTCHA (neither circumvented).
